description: Screenshot the shared tab: the viewport (default), one element, or the full page. Viewport images are in CSS pixels, so x/y read from them work with browser_click/browser_hover. Set annotate=true to draw every snapshot ref (e.g. "e12") on the elements it belongs to; the matching snapshot is returned too.

annotate.description: Label interactive elements with their refs (viewport only)

name: browser_screenshot
